articles.summary: Illinois homeowners can now get rooftop solar paired with a whopping 60-kWh home battery for no money down – but this isn’t free equipment.

articles.title_original: The Genesis GV90 takes luxury up a notch with coach doors and all [Images]
articles.title_zh: Genesis GV90以对开式车门提升豪华感 [图片]
articles.summary: Genesis unveiled its first full-size flagship SUV, the GV90, and it’s about as over-the-top as they come. The ultra-luxe electric SUV packs coach doors, a built-in refrigerator, massive digital screens, air suspension, and plenty of other high-end touches.

articles.title_original: You can now ride a Chinese EV in the US as Waymo opens Zeekr Ojai to all
articles.title_zh: Waymo向公众开放极氪Ojai，美国可乘坐中国电动车
articles.summary:
Waymo is now letting all riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix hail its next-generation Ojai robotaxi — a vehicle built in China by Zeekr.
That makes the Ojai one of the only ways for an American to ride in a Chinese-made EV, a car they still can’t legally buy for themselves.

articles.title_original: This fascinating folding e-bike is lighter than Brompton’s lightest electric bike
articles.title_zh: 这款折叠电动自行车比Brompton最轻的电动自行车还轻
articles.summary: British folding e-bike maker FLIT has just unveiled its latest lightweight folding e-bike, the FLIT M2i. And at just 13.3 kg (29.3 lb), this thing is getting impressively light for a fully equipped electric bike.

articles.title_original: Wawa-branded EV chargers are expanding beyond Tesla
articles.title_zh: Wawa品牌电动汽车充电桩正扩展到特斯拉之外
articles.summary: Wawa launched self-branded Tesla Superchargers earlier this year, and now it’s doing the same with Electrify America EV fast chargers.

articles.title_original: As US tries to starve Cuba, solar electric garbage trikes offer a lifeline
articles.title_zh: 美国试图封锁古巴之际，太阳能电动垃圾三轮车带来一线生机
articles.summary: Cuba is struggling with a US-imposed blockade on fuel shipments, which has led to many crises, including a breakdown in garbage collection in Havana. But a startup is stepping up to collect garbage in one neighborhood, using electric three-wheeled vehicles powered by solar.
